headings.text: Top Wholesale Alloys Supplier Support Junying CNC Machined Parts

meta_description: Junying selected top quality alloy metals supplier to offer aluminum, stainless steel, and more materials for our CNC machining parts manufacturing and CNC services.
monitored_text: As a fast-growing CNC components manufacturer, Junying Metal Manufacturing Co., Limited was founded in 2005, with a registered capital of 3 million, and now has more than 100 employees. We are one of the China best CNC machining companies, specialize in low-cost OEM CNC machining parts manufacturing. The products are mainly used in medical, electronic, aerospace, mechanical, communication, toys, intelligent equipment, and other industries. We have invested in a lot of quality and production environments. In 2015, We passed the quality system review of SGS Company and got the first “ISO9001:2015” certificate. In 2016, we passed the environment system review of SGS Company. Junying has carefully implemented each regulation in management details in accordance with ISO, and fully guaranteed the CNC machining product quality and customer satisfaction. Junying CNC Machining Capabilities Junying has vertical, horizontal, 3 axis, 4 axis and 5 axis CNC machines with tolerances of ± .0002 in and ±.005 mm, which can be used to manufacture the OEM parts. Materials that can be processed by CNC Machining are carbon steel, stainless steel, aluminum, steel, alloy steels, brass, nickel, cobalt, tungsten, titanium, etc. We also have other services such as grinding, milling, turning, trimming, drilling, deburring, tapping, threading, sandblasting, polishing, vibratory finishing, pressure testing, washing and assembly. Junying’s heat treatment includes T4, T5, T6, and T7, which allows weldability, glue joining, rivet, and low porosity shapes. Top Wholesale Alloys Supplier Support Junying CNC Machined Parts Support by China excellent alloy material suppliers such as WixSteel Industrial Corp, their high-speed steel , which has good performance with CNC machining, we can produce high precision, high-quality CNC machining parts for our high-end customer.
